title: Dog-Friendly 5BR Seagrove Beach Home with a Private Pool
meta_description: Relax at 139 N Ryan St, a dog-friendly 5BR, 3.5BA private home in Seagrove Beach, with a private pool, and access to two community pools. Sleeps up to 12.
description_expanded: Welcome to the perfect vacation setup at 139 N Ryan in the Summer's Edge community. This Seagrove home with a private pool and access to two community pools sleeps up to 12 guests across 4 bedrooms and a sleeping loft/bunk room. It's dog-friendly and comes with 5 bikes for exploring the area!The main living space combines the living, dining, and kitchen areas, creating a comfortable place for everyone to gather. Spend an evening watching a movie on the large TV or enjoy a home-cooked meal (or takeout) at the dining table for 6, with 3 additional seats at the kitchen counter. Bedroom 1 is located on the 1st floor and features a twin-over-full bunk bed, a compact shower, a closet, and a TV, perfect for children but a bit snug for adults. Three more bedrooms are on the 2nd floor, and the sleeping loft is on the 3rd floor, accessed by a charming spiral staircase. All bedrooms are equipped with TVs, so everyone can enjoy their favorite shows. Off the 2nd floor landing, there is a convenient workspace. Just don't work too hard on vacation.Step outside and enjoy the private pool, with the home wrapping around it to create a cozy courtyard feel. Lounge in the sun, dine poolside, or fire up the gas grill for a backyard BBQ. If you are looking for more places to cool off, two community pools are just a short stroll away.For those who love to explore, the Eastern Lake Trailhead is just across the street behind YOLO, offering trails for hiking and biking. Plus, you are close to local restaurants and shopping, making it easy to enjoy everything the area has to offer.Sleeping Arrangements:1st Floor, Bedroom 1: Twin-over-full bunk bed with twin trundle, TV and Shower Area. (small room for kids and not functional for adults)2nd Floor Bedroom 2: King bed, TV and private bathroom with dual vanities, tub and shower.2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: King bed, TV and private bathroom2nd Floor, Bedroom 4: King bed, TV and private bathroom3rd Floor, Sleeping Loft: 2 sets of twin-over-twin bunk beds, TV.Beach Access:Head down N. Ryan Road and across Eastern Lake Road down S. Ryan. The beach access pergola is to the left of the pool. Take this path, turn right at the "T" and you'll see your beach access sign to take the boardwalk to your access.Distance: .3 miles | Time: 5 minutes walkingSummer's Edge:Summer’s Edge is tucked along quiet tree-lined streets where kids can ride bikes and play. Only one side of the main street is open while the other side is gated for owners, but rarely used. The neighborhood has 2 community pools, 1 at the end of S. Ryan (near the beach access point) that is heated seasonally and another pool on Chelsea Loop.5 Bikes Included:We are thrilled to include 5 bikes with your rental through our partnership with Vacayzen. These bikes will be at the rental waiting for you when you check-in. You now have one less thing to worry about as you plan out your 30A vacation with Benchmark Management.Your stay at 139 N Ryan St comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Parking for 3 cars* Pool heat can be added for an additional fee* Golf carts are not allowed in the Summer's Edge community.* Dog Friendly: If bringing a pet, an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. Please contact us if you are bringing a dog. A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed at a maximum of 30 lbs. Please see our rental policies for further details.A starter set of amenities is provided: The kitchen includes paper towels, a sponge, dish soap, dishwasher pods, kitchen wipes, trash liners, and laundry pods. Each bathroom has toilet paper, facial and bath soaps, body wash, shampoo, and conditioner. Towels include one body towel and washcloth per guest, plus two hand towels per bathroom.
